name: Camera Plus
summary: Pulls the camera further out than the settings allow and keeps three camera angles you can jump back to with one command.
logoPrompt: A small vintage brass film camera with a long extended lens, seen from the front at a slight angle, with a soft blue glow inside the lens

cover.tagline: Zoom out further, jump back to your angle.

description: **Camera Plus lets your camera zoom out as far as the game permits and remembers up to three camera positions for each character.**
- Raises the maximum camera distance beyond the game's normal limit, up to the farthest it allows.
- Pick a smaller step if the full distance is too much.
- Switching it off puts back the distance you had before.
- Three saved camera positions per character, back with one command.
- Your choice is set again on every login.

Type `/cplus far` and scroll out. `/cplus far 2.2` picks a step between 1 and 2.6, `/cplus off` turns it off. `/cplus save 1` (up to 3) stores the current camera, `/cplus 1` returns to it. `/cplus` alone shows the state and all commands.
- During combat a change waits until the fight is over.
- If another addon or a console command changes the camera distance setting, Camera Plus switches off and keeps that value.
- The first-person view and the game's default view stay untouched.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
